spans.s:
प्र-तोद, अस्, m. a goad; a long whip; an in-
strument of torment; अङ्गिरसाम् प्रतोदः and
कश्यपस्य प्रतोदः, N. of two Sāmans.
प्रतोद प्र-तोद. See under प्र-तुद्, col. 1.
प्र-तोदिन्, ई, इनी, इ, striking; piercing.

प्र-तोष, अस्, m. ‘gratification,’ N. of one of the
twelve sons of Manu Svāyambhuva.

प्रतोली प्र-तोली, f. a broad way, high
street, principal road through a town or village; a
kind of bandage applied to the neck and to the penis.

प्रतोलीक, अस्, आ, अम्, (at the end of a comp.)
having a high street.
